text:
alisa: quick heads-up, opened a tiny PR to reword the tiering examples and add a minimal curl + SDK sample + grafana target. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5210

matt: nice. two quick asks: show Authorization header explicitly and add a one-line sample response shape so readers know keys.

sanjay: also add a short FAQ note: tier credits prorated per-second and billing rounds at run time. mention reserved credits are consumed first.

alisa: draft snippets below (kept short):

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.usage.query(start="2026-04-01T00:00:00Z", end="2026-04-30T00:00:00Z", breakdown="tier", filters={"product":"embedding-service"})
print(resp.metrics)
# -> [{"tier":"startup","tokens":12345},{"tier":"enterprise","tokens":67890}]
```

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/query \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"start":"2026-04-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-04-30T00:00:00Z","breakdown":"tier","filters":{"product":"embedding-service"}}'
```

leo: tiny grafana target to paste in the docs: `{"title":"Tokens by tier","targets":[{"expr":"sum by (tier)(redwood_usage_tokens_total{product=\"embedding-service\"})","legendFormat":"{{tier}}"}]}`
